item.title: Holistic evaluation for deployment
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 16 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01968-8

Thermoelectric technologies can convert waste heat directly into clean electricity, but high laboratory efficiency does not necessarily translate into practical deployment. By revisiting the long-neglected material zinc antimonide, researchers now show that strong thermoelectric performance can go hand in hand with affordability and sustainability.

item.title: Unlocking sustainable thermoelectric generation with zinc antimonide
item.content:encoded:
Nature Sustainability, Published online: 16 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01986-6

Thermoelectric technologies must balance conversion efficiency with resource sustainability. Here the authors demonstrate that eco-friendly zinc antimonide (ZnSb) is a viable materials choice, delivering ~8% efficiency alongside exceptional cost-effectiveness.
